label: PF Backlog 87
title: Backend: artifacts .md canonical + derived .pdf rendering/embed endpoint
body:
Decision: .md is the CANONICAL artifact format (diffable, agent-consumable, single source); .pdf/.svg are DERIVED renderings for human review/embedding, generated on demand (never hand-edited; kind=derived). Add a render endpoint (GET /api/v1/artifacts/{path}?format=pdf|html) using core/pdf_generator, and mark the dashboard workflow diagram PDF the same way (BI-0065).

[OWNER DECISION 2026-09-22] DYNAMIC ARTIFACT FORMAT POLICY.
.md is the CANONICAL default for every artifact; ADDITIONAL formats
(.pdf/.docx/.xlsx/.pptx/.svg/.drawio ...) are chosen DYNAMICALLY per project + artifact type AT THE
AGENT level (specs->pdf/docx; data model/ER->png/svg/drawio; test results->xlsx; decks/marketing->pptx).
Derived formats are GENERATED, never hand-edited. Canonical policy item: forge:artifact-format-policy.

SEE ALSO (decision 3): diagrams must actually render to .drawio/SVG/PDF - the
"[DIAGRAMS] ... 0 rendered via unavailable" outcome is unacceptable.

decisions.note: Dynamic artifact format policy: md canonical default + derived pdf/docx/xlsx/pptx/svg/drawio per agent+doc-type
